title: packs.toml
description: Texture packing config for `pano`, read from `packs.toml` in the current directory or from the path given to `--config`. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Unknown keys are ignored, matching the loader. See src/packer/config.gleam for the loader.

jar.description: Path to the libGDX runnable TexturePacker jar. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

vips.description: `vips` executable: a bare name is looked up on PATH, a path containing `/` resolves against this file's directory.

concurrency.description: Number of atlas pack jobs to run concurrently. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Overridable via the GDX_CONCURRENCY environment variable.

atlases.description: The atlas registry. Must have at least one entry.

name.description: Atlas name, used as the output filename stem.

source_dir.description: Source image directory for this atlas. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

target_dir.description: Output root for this atlas. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Overridable for every atlas at once via the GDX_OUT_ROOT environment variable.

variants.description: Named scale passes. Absent/empty means pack once at factor 1.0, writing directly into `target_dir`. Otherwise each variant writes to `<target_dir>/<variant name>/`.

pot.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: pad output pages to power-of-two dimensions.

padding_x.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: horizontal padding between packed images, in pixels.

padding_y.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: vertical padding between packed images, in pixels.

edge_padding.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: apply padding to the edges of the packed page.

duplicate_padding.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: fill padding by duplicating the edge pixels of each image.

rotation.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: allow rotating images 90 degrees to improve packing.

strip_whitespace_x.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: strip transparent horizontal whitespace from source images before packing.

strip_whitespace_y.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: strip transparent vertical whitespace from source images before packing.

alpha_threshold.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: alpha value below which a pixel is considered transparent for whitespace stripping.

filter_min.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: minification texture filter, e.g. `Nearest`, `Linear`, `MipMapLinearLinear`. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

filter_mag.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: magnification texture filter, e.g. `Nearest`, `Linear`. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

format.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: pixel format of the packed page. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

max_width.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: maximum width of a packed page, in pixels.

max_height.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: maximum height of a packed page, in pixels.

combine_subdirectories.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: combine images from subdirectories of `source_dir` into the parent atlas.

flatten_paths.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: use only the image filename, discarding its subdirectory path, as the packed region name.

use_indexes.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: use `_<index>` filename suffixes to indicate animation frame indices.

bleed.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: bleed transparent pixel colors into the padding to avoid dark edges from filtering.

scale_resampling.description: libGDX TexturePacker setting: resampling filter used when downscaling for a variant's factor. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

factor.description: Downscale factor forwarded to libGDX TexturePacker for this variant's pass, e.g. `0.5` for a half-size output. Accepted as an int or float TOML literal; the loader rejects only non-finite values.

compression.description: Named re-encoding outputs for this variant. Absent/empty skips re-encoding. Each entry writes to `<target_dir>/<variant name>/<compression name>/`.

Options for one `vips pngsave` invocation. Every vips PNG option is available here. Out-of-range numbers are clamped by vips rather than rejected, so the bounds below mark values that would be silently altered; `depth` is the exception and fails outright. Keys absent from the file are left out of the vips call entirely, so vips applies its own default.

depth.description: Output bit depth, vips `bitdepth`. vips accepts only 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 and errors on any other value. A depth of 8 or less selects palette quantisation (libimagequant); a larger one uses every row filter instead, to maximise zlib compression. Set `palette` or `filter` explicitly to override that choice. vips default 8.

quality.description: Quantisation quality, vips `Q`, 0 to 100. Always sent, but only meaningful when palette quantisation is active. vips default 100.

dither.description: Dithering strength for palette quantisation, vips `dither`, 0 to 1. Accepted as an int or float TOML literal. vips default 1.0.

compression.description: zlib compression level, vips `compression`, 0 to 9. Higher is smaller and slower. vips default 6.

strip.description: Shorthand for the common metadata case: `true` sends `keep = ["none"]`, `false` omits the option so vips keeps everything. Cannot be combined with `keep`, which sets the same vips option.

keep.description: Which metadata blocks to retain, vips `keep`. A set of flags, joined with `:` on the way to vips, e.g. `["exif", "icc"]`. `none` and `all` are absorbing. Cannot be combined with `strip`. vips keeps every block by default.

interlace.description: Write an interlaced (Adam7) PNG, vips `interlace`. Requires the full image in memory. vips default `false`.

filter.description: libpng row filters applied before compression, vips `filter`. A set of flags, joined with `:` on the way to vips, e.g. `["sub", "up"]`. `none` is absorbing. Defaults to `["all"]` unless `depth` selects palette quantisation; an empty array omits the option. vips default `none`.

palette.description: Quantise to a palette (indexed) PNG via libimagequant, vips `palette`. Defaults to on when `depth` is 8 or less; set it here to override. vips default `false`.

effort.description: CPU effort for palette quantisation, vips `effort`, 1 to 10. Higher is better quality and slower. vips default 7.

background.description: Background colour used when flattening alpha, vips `background`. RGB or RGBA components, e.g. `[255, 255, 255]`. Ints and floats both work.

page_height.description: Page height for a multi-page save, in pixels, vips `page-height`. vips default 0.

profile.description: ICC profile to embed, vips `profile`. Either a built-in name (`srgb`, `p3`, `cmyk`) or a path to a profile file, which resolves against this file's directory. A bare name is passed through so the built-in lookup keeps working.
